# Energy Pulse

> A design skill that adds a glowing, breathing WebGL light ribbon (white-hot pulsing core, light racing along hundreds of strands, soft ambient light while scrolling) to any website. One accent colour, dark or light theme, no dependencies.

- [SKILL.md: how to apply it](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rimidalvsulrod/energy-pulsing-effect-for-websites/main/skills/energy-pulse/SKILL.md)
- [energy-pulse.js: preset and mount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rimidalvsulrod/energy-pulsing-effect-for-websites/main/skills/energy-pulse/assets/energy-pulse.js)
- [ribbon-engine.js: WebGL2 engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rimidalvsulrod/energy-pulsing-effect-for-websites/main/skills/energy-pulse/assets/ribbon-engine.js)
- [energy-pulse.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rimidalvsulrod/energy-pulsing-effect-for-websites/main/skills/energy-pulse/assets/energy-pulse.css)
- [EnergyPulse.tsx: React / Next.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rimidalvsulrod/energy-pulsing-effect-for-websites/main/skills/energy-pulse/assets/EnergyPulse.tsx)
- [Engine reference and tuning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rimidalvsulrod/energy-pulsing-effect-for-websites/main/skills/energy-pulse/references/engine.md)
